features.description: Unified route response headers and registration validation
acceptance_criteria: Both forms × both paths send X-Frame-Options and CSP through the real server; Result.Ok coverage exercises the existing unwrap behavior.
Json preserves exact underscore names; record names remap; _headers metadata is absent from serialized response bodies and original eval records are not mutated.
Invalid shapes, non-string fields/JObject values, invalid names and control characters produce structured 500 responses plus ERROR logs naming accepted forms and offending fields.
Declared incompatible @route _headers types are refused at registration; valid record/Json declarations remain accepted.
Reserved-header attempts fail loudly on both paths and cannot overwrite CORS, Vary or timing; valid program Content-Type wins over defaults.
Raw string, bytes and JSON body defaults appear on the wire before status commitment.
New runnable example checks and serves all four combinations; request-side mcp_tools and serve_api_mcp_header_auth fixtures and their auth suite remain unchanged and pass.
Temporarily reverting the remap or raw Json acceptance makes the corresponding production wire test fail; restore changes afterward.
features.notes: Commit d250d0b5. Shared eval.Value extraction, record remap, exact Json names, atomic validation, server-owned header refusal, registration alias/Result checks, Content-Type ordering. Both forms × both paths + Result wire matrix pass, bad header handlers log ERROR and return structured 500. Both mutation tests fail as intended; restored suite passes. AILANG prompt version loaded: v0.16.6. Showcase effects: pure signatures; contracts skipped because behavior is HTTP metadata at hosting boundary; inline tests skipped because no-input handlers are covered by real server tests. Guide examples and response/auth examples check. Existing mcp_tools.ail Option[string] vs string error reproduces on installed pre-sprint binary; request fixture unchanged.
